- Strata distributes the model across GPU, RAM, and SSD: GPU keeps hot layers, cache, and frequently used experts; RAM holds all experts with CPU/GPU parallel execution; SSD streams the n-gram table using direct I/O and quantized formats.

- Inference is accelerated by MTP token speculation, prompt lookup for repeated context, and chunked prompt processing with expert streaming and adaptive ring sizing.

- Strata is MIT-licensed, while model/quantization weights have separate licenses; it builds on llama.cpp/ggml components such as i-quant formats, GPU kernels, CPU backend, and vision support.
